initialHarnessIssue: The first targeted router invocation used Vitest's default config and failed to import cloudflare:workers before collecting tests. Re-running with tests/vitest.config.ts passed all 78 assertions; this was a test invocation/configuration issue, not an application failure.
limitations: This slice validates manifest and variable parity, focused router authorization/CORS/dispatch behavior, and connected local Wrangler bindings. It does not execute every literal route in all 26 Workers individually.
Connected probes use local Wrangler and synthetic credentials; no deployed Cloudflare account or external provider was exercised.
A complete per-route inventory with explicit auth, request limits, error contract, and tested/disabled reason remains outstanding.
